newsitem.title: GERMANY: INSTANT VIEW - Failure of Germany's tax talks.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Failure of Germany's tax talks.

text.p: The following are reactions to the rejection of Germany's parliamentary mediation committee on Thursday of sweeping government tax reforms given to Reuters Financial Television:
GUENTER REDEKER, SENIOR ECONOMIST, CHASE INVESTMENT BANK, LONDON

"We have to recognise that German corporations face a total tax burden of around 58 percent on profits...This big tax gap is an invitation for companies to look at transferring profits to other countries if possible, which means the investment cycle will be weaker in Germany and means the labour market could continue to have problems.
